title: [BUG] `import crewai` takes >25 seconds
description:
### Description

`import crewai` takes >25 seconds

### Steps to Reproduce

1. `import crewai` 
2. run the script
3. wait 25 seconds or longer

### Expected behavior

The library should be imported in fraction of second. 

### Screenshots/Code snippets

```py
import time
start = time.time()

import crewai

print(time.time() - start)
```

### Operating System

Windows 10

### Python Version

3.12

### crewAI Version

0.32.2

### crewAI Tools Version

0.3.0

### Virtual Environment

Venv

### Evidence

![Code_wIKMXiY1iv](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0d73a7e8-4dd4-4584-a476-f836e95d0fb9)


### Possible Solution

None
